title: use_fullcoul_exx=f is silently overridden when use_abacus_gw_symmetry=t
symptom: Turning use_fullcoul_exx off appears accepted, but the EXX bands are byte-identical (same md5) with the flag on; the log line says the symmetry branch builds V(R) directly from the full IBZ operator and switches to read_Vq_full.
root_cause: With GW symmetry enabled, LibRPA takes the IBZ full-Coulomb branch regardless of use_fullcoul_exx; the flag is not effective in that combination. Directly forcing the flag can also trip an exx.cpp assertion requiring parallel_routing=libri.
minimal_fix: When the symmetry lane is on, do not claim cut-Coulomb EXX; if a cut-Coulomb definition is required, run it with the symmetry lane off and compare only against a definition-matched benchmark.
validation: Compare EXX_band md5 with and without the flag under symmetry: identical outputs prove the flag was ignored.
avoid: Reading 'flag accepted' as 'flag effective'; check the log line and the output hash.
